name: Brushed aluminum
where_seen: The plate the VIN is struck on, the brand, a dialog's head, and every key: a button is a key of this metal, raised on a steel ledge.
texture: A fine horizontal brush over a light-to-mid grey gradient; characters are struck in, lit below and shadowed above. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Aluminum, pressed
where_seen: A key held down, the mode shown, and a stock strip that is open: flush, 2px down, with an inner shadow.
texture: The metal a step darker, the tape's ridges across it, no brush.

name: The second tape
where_seen: The part type picker's key, a part type opened recently, and a candidate's stock strip: a name that is pressed.
texture: Embossing tape in the plate's own metal: the brushed aluminum with the tape's faint ridges over it.

name: Label tape
where_seen: A tag's number band, the names under the cards, and a strip naming what a panel holds: stuck on, static.
texture: Black label-maker vinyl with faint ridges across it and a lit top edge; letters are raised white. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Label tape, pressed
where_seen: A control of label tape held down or chosen.
texture: The tape darker, its ridges stronger, its gradient turned over.

name: Manila
where_seen: Every card of the decode and every candidate: a parts tag hung by its eyelet from its group's line.
texture: A parts tag's stock with tooth, clipped corners and a reinforced patch around its eyelet; ink is printed on it. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Pinstripe tape
where_seen: The brackets over the plate, the leader lines to the cards, and the rails to the candidates: one colour for each group of the VIN.
texture: A 5px line of coloured tape, lit on its upper left edge and casting a small shadow on the ground. Six colours, shown as the light scheme has them; the dark scheme's are lighter.
css: linear-gradient(#c8102e 0 0) 0 10px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#0b4fa8 0 0) 0 22px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#5b2d8e 0 0) 0 78px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#a34c09 0 0) 0 90px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#0f6b46 0 0) 100% 0 / 5px 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#3d4650 0 0) calc(100% - 12px) 0 / 5px 100% no-repeat, #dcecf7

name: The ground, light
where_seen: The page itself in the light scheme, behind every material.
texture: A flat pale blue. Not a material: what the materials sit on and cast their shadows on.

name: The ground, dark
where_seen: The page itself in the dark scheme.
texture: A flat dark blue. The metal, the tape and the manila do not change over it; the pinstripes lighten.
